Plugin.Name: UGREEN DXP4800 Pro LEDs
Plugin.Overview: Controls the Power, LAN and four drive-bay LEDs on the UGREEN DXP4800 Pro. Configurable colours, disk activity pulses and standby breathing. Beta: supports only Unraid 7.3.2 with kernel 6.18.38-Unraid. Confirm physical bay mapping before enabling disk LEDs. Remove competing LED plugins before installation.
